description:
Indulge in the exquisite artistry of the late 19th to early 20th century with this magnificent export-grade Balkan/Ottoman-style belt buckle. Known traditionally as a pafta or girdle clasp, this piece beautifully exemplifies the rich ethnographic jewelry traditions of regions like Bulgaria, Greece, and North Macedonia.
•          Crafted with high-level precision, the structural framework features a heavy-duty central junction bar made of solid silver, explicitly verified by a clear, authentic STERLING stamp on the crescent-shaped interlocking hook. The front face show cases a striking three-part polylobed layout, highlighting a prominent central medallion framed by two intricate, wing-like side panels.
•          The entire facade is adorned with gorgeous metal openwork filigree, fine wire scrolls, and delicate floral motifs. It is heavily embellished with polished, round green and purple glass cabochons. In regional bridal and festive attire, these colorful faux gems were historically used to signify wealth and offer protection against evil.
•          This high-quality folk revival or grand-tour export item is remarkably intact. All the colored glass cabochons remain original and securely set, and the delicate openwork shows exceptional preservation. It serves as a premier addition to any antique costume, silver filigree, or ethnographic jewelry collection.
•          Measurements: Measure about 5” long by 3”wide
•          Condition: Antique condition with a beautiful, natural aged patina. The filigree work is complete, and all glass elements are intact. The reverse belt slider mechanism and closure hook function smoothly.
•          Estimated Value: $300 - $800

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This lot contains assorted mineral and crystal specimens including raw geodes, tumbled stones, and crystal points. The collection features various minerals such as amethyst clusters, citrine, quartz, pyrite, selenite, rose quartz, and fluorite among others.

Specifications:
- Includes several raw geodes with natural crystalline interiors
- Contains tumbled stones and crystal points
- Includes bags of small mineral chips or gravel

description:
Natural Polished Agate Geode Slice with Crystalline Druzy Pocket Gray White
Natural polished agate geode slice specimen in 2 halves featuring gray and white banded patterns with a small crystalline druzy pocket in the upper center. The piece has a natural, unpolished brown/tan outer rind and a smooth, glossy polished cut face revealing concentric agate banding in shades of gray, lavender, and white. Includes views from multiple angles including a split view showing the two halves. This is a raw mineral/rock specimen suitable for display, collecting, or crafting. Condition is natural/as-found with no artificial alterations beyond cutting and polishing. No brand or manufacturer as this is a natural stone specimen. Two slices together measures approximately 8x8". Wares: May have  gentle wear. May have markings, staining, scuff marks, scratches or  damage that was missed when photographing.
